title: Q-SPEC-17-kit-remediation-contract: retry bound, backoff, deadline and a half-open probe on the kit's failure items (US-17-R04, R07, R08, R09)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q max_attempts -- seed/worker/src/selfaudit.js
**Status:** closed

specs/US-SPEC-17-failure-modes-and-remediation.md section 10.2 lists as PLANNED: the kit's failure items (seed/worker/src/selfaudit.js) carry owner role, done check and closing probe, but no `max_attempts`, backoff or deadline; an exhausted item is not escalated through the gate or reassigned; the loop breaker schedules no half-open probe; a detector whose firings are never confirmed is not put on probation. All four are built and tested in workers/core/kernel/failure.js and not used by the tick a deployed system runs.

Carry the contract fields on the register's modes in seed/autonomy/failure-modes.json (with its schema), have `selfAuditStep` and `loopBreak` honour them (retry at the next backoff step, reassign or gate after the bound, one scheduled retry after the breaker opens, probation by confirmed share), without a new table where the items table can hold the state, and add tests named for the four requirements. Then move the lines in section 10.2 to BUILT.

**Prediction:** selfaudit_reads_max_attempts >= 1 within 336 h (the number of lines the done check finds; 0 today)
**Out of scope:** weakening or removing any probe in seed/autonomy/failure-modes.json, or changing workers/core/kernel/failure.js.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q max_attempts -- seed/worker/src/selfaudit.js (exit 0): the kit reads the retry bound. Its tests pass in `cd seed/worker && node test/run.mjs`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
